items.how: Turnover and contribution figures. (Retired: applicability is now worked out automatically from the client's figures.)
items.text: Audit required: turnover above Rs 40 lakh or contribution above Rs 25 lakh.

steps: Check Form 11 and Form 8 filing dates on MCA
items.text: Form 11 (by 30 May) and Form 8 (by 30 October) filed for the previous year.

steps: List changes in partners / LLP agreement
items.text: Changes in LLP agreement or partners filed with ROC.

steps: Confirm books are kept at the registered office
items.text: Books maintained at registered office on double-entry, accrual or cash basis as permitted.
